text.official_en: <TH>

わかりまして？　では、そろそろ始めましょう……
真の薔薇を決める、至高の戦いを！
text.official_en:
Understood? Then, without further ado, let us finally
settle who is the superior rose!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おーっほほほ！　あたくしたちが優勢ですわね！
レイリダーナ……腕が鈍ったのではなくて？
text.official_en:
Ohoho! Victory is within my grasp! Your skills
have dulled, my dear Leilidahna!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こ……このあたくしが苦戦を強いられるなんて……
レイリダーナ……負けませんわよ！
text.official_en:
How is it I've been put on my back foot?!
No matter... I will defeat you, Leilidahna!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
制限時間が来たようですわね……
それでは、結果の発表を致しましょう。
text.official_en: Time is up. Now, I shall announce the results.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

まず、あたくしたちの赤い炎が灯った
灯籠の数は……「<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

My team's final tally of captured flames appears
to be...<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

そして、あなたがたの青い炎が灯った
灯籠の数は……「<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
く……この勝負の勝者は……
レイリダーナ……あなたがたですわ！
text.official_en:
Which means... *sigh* You have bested me again,
Leilidahna.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おーっほっほっほ！！　残念でしたわね……
勝者はあたくしたちでしてよー！！
text.official_en: Ohoho! How dreadfully sad for you—I won!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp: オリンピア様！　我々もお手伝いいたします！
text.official_en: We will assist you, Olympia!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
無粋なことを……
真剣勝負に、水を差されましたわね……
text.official_en:
How unsporting! This threatens the integrity of the
competition.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あたしなら構わないわ。
面白くなって、丁度いいじゃない……
text.official_en: I don't mind. Makes things more interesting.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レヒネル……待っていなさい。
その首、すぐに掻き切ってあげるわ！
text.official_en: Just wait, Lechner, until I slit your neck!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
姫……はやるお気持ちはわかりますが、
焦りは禁物ですぞ。
text.official_en:
Milady, I understand your eagerness, but being
hasty won't serve us.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レヒネル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあてと……
男どもは皆殺し、女は俺のものだ！
text.official_en:
Let's see now... Soldiers, kill all the men. The women,
I'll keep!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うわあ、こいつ最低だ。こういうのには
絶対近づくなって、お母さんがよく言ってたよ。
text.official_en:
Yuck... Gross. Mom warned me to stay away from
guys like him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この機会を待っていたわ！
レヒネル、覚悟！
text.official_en:
I've waited a long time for this chance. Are you
ready to die, Lechner?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レヒネル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうは行くかよ、女！
ここで返り討ちにしてやるぜ！
text.official_en:
Not going to happen, girlie. Because I'm going to
kill you first!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レヒネル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
俺の噂くらいは知ってるんだろう？
“狂犬”の恐ろしさ、味わわせてやる！
text.official_en:
You've heard of me, yes? Heard the terrifying stories
of the Mad Dog? You'll find out they're all true!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こいつら……かなり、やる。
高い練度と周囲との連携……只者ではない。
text.official_en:
These are no ordinary soldiers. Highly skilled and
coordinated, using the terrain to their advantage.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
奴がいかに親衛隊長という立場とはいえ、
これほどの連中を使えるものだろうか。
text.official_en:
I don't see how, even as captain of the king's guard,
he would have authority to command such elites.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしや……奴らの背後には、
大きな組織が存在しているということか？
text.official_en:
I wonder if... Perhaps there's another organization
at his back?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
くそ、一体どれほどの増援が……
姫、これではこちらが持ちませぬ。
text.official_en:
The stream of reinforcements is not slowing, milady.
And we can only hold out for so long.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここは一旦下がり、
次の機会を待ちましょう……！
text.official_en: I suggest falling back and waiting for another chance.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………くっ、もう少しで……
あの男に止めを刺せるのに……！
text.official_en:
But...damn it! I almost had him! I could practically
feel my hands wrapping around his neck!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おれもバッカニア殿に賛成だ。
ここは退こう、レダ嬢。
text.official_en:
I concur with Buccar. We'd be well advised to
retreat, Miss Leda.
text.real_en:
I concur with Buccaneer. We'd be well advised to
retreat, Miss Leda.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
心配するな。レヒネルは今の立場上、
そう容易にはダグシオンを離れられん筈だ。
text.official_en:
If it's any comfort, in his current position, Lechner
will be restrained from leaving Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
機会はかならず、また巡ってくる。
ここは、おれを信じてくれ。
text.official_en:
Which means we will have another opportunity.
Trust me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ………………わかったわ。
text.official_en: Fine, alright.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レヒネルめ……飄々としているが隙がない。
不用意に手を出すのは危険ですぞ。
text.official_en:
Damn Lechner. He's more tactical than he seems—
and his defenses are airtight. We have to be careful.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ああいった手練れの中には、<#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レヒネル
US EN person identifier agrees

多少はやるようだが……多勢に無勢って奴だぜ。
てめえら！　出てきてこいつらと遊んでやれ！
text.official_en:
Fine, so you might be competent...but you're also
outnumbered. Come out and play, guys!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……見つけたわよ。
絶対にここで仕留めるわ。
text.official_en: There it is. No time to waste—let's take it out.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
な……なにこれ！？
人間でもないし、動物でもないし……？
text.official_en:
What the HECK is that thing? It's not human...but it
doesn't look like an animal either.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おれが思うに……これは、こいつの
本来の姿ではないのではないだろうか。
text.official_en:
If I were to posit a guess, I'd wager this is not its
intended form.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
例えば……不完全な召喚を行われた結果、
正しい姿をとることが出来なかったような……
text.official_en:
Perhaps, say, someone attempted to summon the
beast, but only did so partially...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも……なぜかしら。この怪異は、
もっと禍々しくて不安定なものを感じる……
text.official_en:
Eugh! That's well and good, but why does the
Phantom look so ghastly and...unstable?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……レダ嬢、貴女はもしや、
この怪異に心当たりでもあるのではないか？
text.official_en:
Miss Leda. You wouldn't know where this Phantom
came from, would you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

……あるわけないでしょう、そんなの。
馬鹿なことを言う暇があるなら、働きなさい。
text.official_en:
No. Why the hell would I? Stop your idiotic
theorizing and focus on the fight!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

……どうにか、片付いたようですな。
しかし、不気味な敵もいたものです。
text.official_en: What a disturbing foe that was.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかし……ダグシオンは、いつのまに
これほど危険な街になってしまったのか……
text.official_en: When did Dagsion become so dangerous?

text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

事前に聞いておりました通り……
相手の方は重装が中心ですのね。

I believe we've all heard that our opponents are
heavily armored.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

なら、障害物を利用するなり、
頑丈な人たちに敵を足止めしてもらって
text.official_en:
In that case, here's what I'd suggest. We hold them
back with obstacles and our sturdiest fighters...

US EN person identifier agrees

後方から魔法で間接攻撃をすれば、

text.official_en:
and then blow them to bits from a distance
with magic. That ought to work, right?

僕たちのサラマンダーもありますし、

We have our Salamanders as well, so I think your
strategy makes sense.

text.jp: <TH>

US EN person identifier agrees

あんたたち、あれはちゃんと持ってきたね？
虎の子だ。使い所を間違うんじゃないよ！
text.official_en:
Everyone has it right? The you-know-what?
Let's wait for juuust the right moment to use it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

その時がきたら、あたしが指示を出す。
それまでは我慢するんだ！
text.official_en: I'll give the signal when it's time. Hold back till then.

text.official_en: Yes, ma'am!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
よし……敵の連中は
十分に引き込んだみたいだね。
text.official_en: OK... Got 'em nice and drawn in.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: みんな、今だよ！　あれを使うんだ！
text.official_en: Everyone, now!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

しまった、その手があったのね……！
なかなか、やるじゃない。
text.official_en:
Hell. They had that up their sleeves? Clever move
on their part.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

道具で魔力に対する抵抗力を増幅するとは。
確かに効果的な戦法だ。
text.official_en:
So, they're using items to increase their resistance
to magic. An effective tactic.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

確かにこれならば、重装の兵たちの
弱点が一つ、完全に覆い隠される……！
text.official_en:
That will cover one of the major weaknesses of
heavily armored soldiers.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees

ええっ！？　もしかして魔法が効かないなんて、
どうすればいいんですか私たち！？
text.official_en:
What?! But if our magic won't work, then what are
we gonna do?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……成程、敵もさるもの、というべきかしらね。
さすがは大剣闘祭、一筋縄とはいきませんわ。
text.official_en:
Perhaps we underestimated our enemy. Any match
in the Heroic Games is bound to be a challenge.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ、ここから反撃開始だ！
あのお嬢さんたちを総崩れにしてやりな！
text.official_en: Counterattack time. Let's rout these girls!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ、ダグシオン大剣闘祭で
でっかい爪痕を残してやろうじゃないか！
text.official_en:
Come on! The Heroic Games are a chance to make
our mark.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

パルマの雨の名前をダグシオン中に
知らしめてやるんだ！
text.official_en:
Let's see to it that everyone in Dagsion knows about
the Rains of Palma!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

ああ……負けちまったか……
流石に勝てるとは思ってはなかったけどね。
text.official_en:
Aw, just like that, huh? Well, I knew I wasn't
gonna win anyway.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我ながら善戦したってとこかな……
あの人も褒めてくれるだろうさ……
text.official_en:
At least I gave them a hell of a fight... I know that'd
make him proud.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.official_en: <DLG>The armored knight used pure water.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

そういえば……
あの装置は一体何でしょう？
text.official_en: I've been wondering...what is this exactly?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

恐らくですが……砂漠の気候を再現するための
乾いた空気を生み出す仕掛けでしょう。
text.official_en:
It's a guess as much as anything, but perhaps it
produces dry air to replicate a desert climate.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

！　そうです……あれで空気を更に乾燥させれば、
聖水を無効化することができるかもしれません！
text.official_en:
*gasp* Of course... Using that to dry the air might
mean we can negate the effect of the pure water!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

う……空気が乾いて肌が痛いわ……
でも、聖水が乾いて、意味がなくなったみたいね！
text.official_en:
Urgh... I can just feel my skin cracking, the air's
so dry. But at least it's drying up that pure water!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
きゃっ！　これは……武器でしょうか……？
一体どこから……？
text.official_en: Oh! What's that? A weapon? Where'd it come from?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふ……私からの手向けだ。
そいつで敵を片付けるがいい。
text.official_en:
Hmhm. Consider it an offering from me. Use it to
swiftly dispatch your foes.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
勢いが止まらない……やっぱあんたら流石だね。
でも、こっちだってタダでやられやしないよ！
text.official_en:
You guys just don't quit. I should've expected this.
But I won't be done in so easily!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ！　強力な防御の魔法……！
ジャスミンさん、カチカチですわ。
text.official_en:
Oh, my! What strong magic! Jasmine's defenses
will be so hard to break through now!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
背後にいる呪い師によるものだな。
彼女のさらなる奥の手といったところか……
text.official_en:
This must be the work of the diviner behind her.
Another one of her battle secrets...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんて堅い……！　防御魔法を唱えている
呪い師の方を先に倒したほうが賢いわね……
text.official_en:
Tough defenses. We might want to start by defeating
that diviner casting defensive magic.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめんなさい、呪い師さん……
でも、これで邪魔な魔法は消えましたわ！
text.official_en:
I'm sorry, diviner... But your intrusive magic has
been cleared from play!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp: <DLG>観客からアイテムが投げ入れられました
text.official_en: <DLG>Spectators have thrown items into the arena.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>
